headlines.title: Does T Mix Launch Change The Bull Case For T Mobile (TMUS)?
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US has rolled out T-Mix customizable wireless plans and its fastest T-Mobile Fiber 5 Gig offering, featuring a 10-year price guarantee and bundled equipment, installation and unlimited data across multiple fiber tiers. The push into highly personalized mobile plans and higher speed fiber indicates that T-Mobile US is focusing on premium connectivity demand and richer bundled service relationships with households.

headlines.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Launches T Mix And 5 Gig Fiber, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US (TMUS) has put product development in the spotlight, rolling out its customizable T-Mix wireless plans alongside a new 5 Gig fiber offer that comes with a 10-year price guarantee. T-Mobile US has drawn fresh attention with these launches, yet the 1-year total shareholder return is still down 18.42%, even as the stock shows a 14.98% total shareholder return over three years and 42.57% over five years.

headlines.title: AT&T, T-Mobile Are Reportedly Ready To Boot Boost Mobile If SpaceX Buys It
headlines.summary: Semafor’s Rohan Goswami said that AT&T and T-Mobile have discussed removing Boost Mobile from their networks if SpaceX acquires the EchoStar unit, creating a potential obstacle to Elon Musk’s push to become a major U.S. wireless carrier.

headlines.title: Sorry to Wake You, But T-Mobile and Bryan Cranston Have a Change in Plans
headlines.summary: BELLEVUE, Wash., November 05, 2026--Forget the alarm clock. Bryan Cranston is giving America a wake-up call about wireless plans — and just in case his message isn’t loud enough, he brought a rooster. T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) today unveiled its latest national advertising campaign starring the Emmy®-winning, Tony®-winning and Oscar®-nominated actor to introduce T-Mix, a new way to wireless that lets customers pick what they want, change what they want and skip what they don’t.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of T-Mobile (TMUS) on Nov. 3
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $24.5 million in T-Mobile US stock on Tuesday, with 32 funds buying and 9 selling.

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
